notes.md: - **Largest urban agglomerations (Census 2011):** **Visakhapatnam UA** (about **17.28 lakh**) is the largest in AP; **Vijayawada UA** (about **14.77 lakh**) is second. Both are million-plus UAs.
- **Siemens Centres of Excellence:** APSSDC partnered with **Siemens** to set up Centres of Excellence in engineering colleges (e.g. **JNTU Anantapur**) for industry skills.

new.s: In which mandal is the greenfield capital city of Amaravati located?
new.x: Amaravati is a greenfield city on the Krishna between Vijayawada and Guntur, in Thullur mandal.
new.angle: U0571 notes gap: Amaravati -> Thullur mandal

new.s: Which city is being developed on the banks of the Krishna as India's first smart capital?
new.x: Amaravati, on the banks of the Krishna, is being developed as India's first smart capital.
new.angle: U0571 notes gap: India's first smart capital -> Amaravati

new.s: Which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 is amended by the AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 to make Amaravati the sole capital?
new.x: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 amends Section 5 and makes Amaravati the sole and permanent capital.
new.angle: U0571 notes gap: sole-capital Act -> Section 5

new.s: About how many acres in 7 villages are covered by Amaravati's Land Pooling Scheme 2.0, begun in April 2026?
new.x: LPS 2.0 covers about 16,666 acres in 7 villages; 37,921 acres was Phase I.

new.s: Which project at Sakhamuru in Amaravati will house the State Public Library, an auditorium and the Global Institute of Good Governance?
new.x: Amaravati Sangamam (₹759 crore) at Sakhamuru will house the State Public Library, an auditorium and the Global Institute of Good Governance.
new.angle: U0571 notes gap: Amaravati Sangamam -> Sakhamuru

new.s: For what purpose was the AP Urban Greening and Beautification Corporation set up?
new.x: The AP Urban Greening and Beautification Corporation was set up for greening and beautifying urban areas.

new.s: Which city of Andhra Pradesh was the cleanest in the State, ranking 4th in India, in Swachh Survekshan 2023?
new.x: In Swachh Survekshan 2023, Visakhapatnam was 4th cleanest in India and cleanest in AP; Vijayawada was 6th.

new.s: Which city was named the 'Promising Swachh Shehar' of Andhra Pradesh in Swachh Survekshan 2024-25?
new.x: In Swachh Survekshan 2024-25, Rajahmundry was the Promising Swachh Shehar of AP.
new.angle: U0571 #3 Swachh Survekshan 2024-25 -> Promising Swachh Shehar

new.s: Which was the largest urban agglomeration of Andhra Pradesh as per Census 2011?
new.x: Visakhapatnam UA (about 17.28 lakh) was the largest in AP in 2011; Vijayawada UA (about 14.77 lakh) was second.

new.s: The Andhra Pradesh State Skill Development Corporation was set up in 2014 as a not-for-profit company on the lines of which national body?
new.x: APSSDC was set up in 2014 as a not-for-profit company on the lines of the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC).

new.s: What target has been set for the Naipunyam AI portal of Andhra Pradesh by 2029?
new.x: Naipunyam, the AI portal for skilling, certification and job matching, has a goal of 20 lakh by 2029.

new.s: About how many SHGs come under MEPMA, which runs DAY-NULM in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: MEPMA runs DAY-NULM (urban) and has about 2.74 lakh SHGs.
new.angle: U0572 #6 urban livelihood mission -> data point

new.s: With which company did APSSDC set up Centres of Excellence in engineering colleges of Andhra Pradesh, such as at JNTU Anantapur?
new.x: APSSDC partnered with Siemens to set up Siemens Centres of Excellence in colleges such as JNTU Anantapur for industry skills.

new.s: What is the full form of INDIRAMMA, the housing programme launched in Andhra Pradesh in April 2006?
o: Integrated Novel Development in Rural Areas and Model Municipal Areas
Indira Rural Housing and Model Municipal Areas
Integrated New Development in Rural and Model Mandal Areas
Indira Development of Rural Areas and Model Mega Areas
new.x: INDIRAMMA stands for Integrated Novel Development in Rural Areas and Model Municipal Areas; it began in April 2006.

new.s: What was the annual income ceiling for a white ration card in urban areas of Andhra Pradesh in 2017?
new.x: In 2017 the white ration card ceiling was ₹75,000 a year in urban areas and ₹60,000 in rural areas.
new.angle: U0573 #1 PDS -> white card ceiling (notes gap)

new.s: How many Mobile Dispensing Unit (MDU) vehicles were used for door delivery of ration in Andhra Pradesh from 2021?
new.x: Door delivery (2021) used 9,260 MDU vehicles costing ₹539 crore; it was stopped on 1 May 2025.

new.s: What did the NTR Videsi Vidya Adarana scheme of Andhra Pradesh provide?
o: Overseas-study aid for SC, ST, BC and minority students
Loans to youth for foreign jobs
new.x: NTR Videsi Vidya Adarana gave overseas-study aid to SC, ST, BC and minority students; it was replaced by Jagananna Videshi Vidya Deevena.

new.s: The Dudekula community, listed in Andhra Pradesh's BC list, belongs to which religious group?
new.x: The Dudekula are a Muslim community in AP's BC list; they got special cover in the 2021-22 budget.

new.s: What is the Disha app of Andhra Pradesh?
o: An SOS app for women in distress, linked to Disha police stations
new.x: The Disha app is AP's SOS app for women in distress and is linked to Disha police stations.

new.s: Under YSR Kalyanamasthu and YSR Shaadi Tohfa, what minimum education must the bride and groom have passed?
new.x: Both the bride and groom must have passed SSC; the ages must be 18 and 21.

new.s: What does the Integrated Rural Energy Programme provide?
o: Basic home energy for cooking, heating and lighting, with a renewable focus
Loans to SHGs for solar businesses
new.x: The Integrated Rural Energy Programme gives basic home energy (cooking, heating, lighting) with a renewable focus; it is not a women's income programme.

new.s: Which Constitutional Amendment Act introduced the Goods and Services Tax (GST) in India?
new.x: GST was introduced by the Constitution (101st Amendment) Act, 2016.

new.s: From which date did GST come into force in India?
new.x: After the 101st Amendment Act, 2016, GST came into force on 1 July 2017.

new.s: In the Union Budget, as which statement, and since when, is the Child Budget presented?
new.x: The Child Budget is Statement 12 (since 2009-10); the Gender Budget is Statement 13 (since 2005-06).
new.angle: U0574 #61 gender and child budget -> Child Budget

new.s: With which area of Andhra Pradesh is limestone mainly associated?
new.x: Limestone in AP is mainly found in the Kadapa–Kurnool basins; barytes is at Mangampet and mica in the Nellore belt.

new.s: How much additional borrowing did Andhra Pradesh get in September 2020 for the One Nation One Ration Card reform?
new.x: AP got ₹2,525 crore of extra borrowing for completing the One Nation One Ration Card reform (September 2020).

new.s: How much additional borrowing did Andhra Pradesh get in February 2021 for power-sector reforms?
new.x: In February 2021 AP got ₹1,515 crore of extra borrowing for power-sector reforms, the 2nd State after Madhya Pradesh.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about APSDC:
1. It escrowed liquor revenue to borrow from banks.
2. The AP High Court questioned tax revenue going to APSDC instead of the Consolidated Fund of the State.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: APSDC escrowed liquor revenue to borrow from banks, and the AP High Court questioned tax revenue going to APSDC instead of the Consolidated Fund.
new.angle: U0574 #53 escrow of revenues -> High Court

new.s: Which disasters were newly added to the SDRF/SDMF list under the 16th Finance Commission?
new.x: Under the 16th FC, heatwaves and lightning were added to the disaster list for SDRF/SDMF.

new.s: In which year was the Outcome Budget first introduced in India?
new.x: The Outcome Budget came in 2005, well before the Plan/non-Plan distinction was dropped in 2017-18.

new.s: How many Centrally Sponsored Schemes are covered by SNA-SPARSH for just-in-time release of funds?
new.x: SNA-SPARSH covers 66 CSS in 28 States and 3 UTs, cutting idle float from ₹1.67 to ₹0.4 lakh crore.

new.s: As per Census 2011, what was the child sex ratio of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: AP's child sex ratio was 944 against India's 918; the overall sex ratio was 997.
new.angle: U0576 #12 demographic indicators -> child sex ratio

new.s: Which services sub-sector recorded the lowest growth in Andhra Pradesh in 2025-26?
new.x: In 2025-26, Banking grew fastest (14.25%) and Public Administration slowest (0.09%) among services.

new.s: As per SES 2024-25, how many Community Health Centres (CHCs) are there in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: SES 2024-25 lists 173 CHCs, 1,145 rural and 559 urban PHCs, and 11,086 sub-centres.
